Productive AI requires the meaningful involvement of patients and clinicians throughout the entire process, from co-design and ethics to defining alert thresholds, testing prototypes, assessing application quality, and shaping both feedforward concerns and feedback solutions, all while evaluating workflow integration.

unlisted_practices: Invest in clinical staffing, protected clinical time, and response pathways so that every AI-generated alert has a viable human route to timely clinical care and resolution.
Evaluate downstream clinical response capacity, not only detection accuracy, when implementing AI monitoring and alerting systems.
Define team-based care roles clearly and support them, rather than using advanced practice clinicians as substitutes for unavailable physicians when responding to AI alerts.
